rows.name: Phone formatting preserves international numbers, extensions, identifiers, input and tel links

Astrology uses all historical sign boundaries and rejects impossible dates
Mobile QR reveals the current URL and repeated parameters and blocks an external generator
Copy failure is announced without false success; fallback restores focus and long content is preserved
Scroll controls remain keyboard accessible on mobile and respect reduced motion
Loan timeline declares loaded-row scope and retains partial API enrichment after a page failure
Bibliographic badges explain the matched text and retain a visible alternative when the image fails
New-acquisition badges expose their source date and ignore absent, invalid, future and old dates
Message chronology handles equal and missing dates, dynamic additions and restores native nodes
Reservation guard releases rejected native validation, blocks slow duplicate submissions and treats labels as text
Reservation AJAX guard waits for an explicit result and restores the original button after failure
Long list counters preserve input and existing descriptions while comparing bounded duplicate samples
Call-number search previews mixed prefixes and encodes accents, ampersands and quotes without changing the native link
